```gherkin
Feature: GUI Display Requirements

  Scenario: Display Patient Pressure
    Given the controller is sending data to the GUI
    And the patient pressure is 20 cmH2O
    When the GUI displays the patient pressure
    Then the GUI displays the patient pressure as 20 cmH2O

  Scenario: GUI Graph Refresh Rate
    Given the GUI graph refresh rate is set to 20 Hz
    When the GUI graph is updated
    Then the GUI graph is updated at a rate of at least 20 Hz

  Scenario: GUI Graph Duration
    Given the GUI graph duration is set to 30 seconds
    When the GUI graph is updated
    Then the GUI graph is updated for 30 seconds

  Scenario: Display Inspiratory Tidal Volume
    Given the inspiratory tidal volume is 500 mL
    When the GUI displays the inspiratory tidal volume
    Then the GUI displays the inspiratory tidal volume as 500 mL with a resolution of 1 mL

  Scenario: Display Ratio of Inspiration Time to Expiration Time
    Given the ratio of inspiration time to expiration time is 15:1
    When the GUI displays the ratio
    Then the GUI displays the ratio as 15:1 with a display resolution of 0.1

  Scenario: Display PEEP
    Given the PEEP is 5 cmH2O
    When the GUI displays the PEEP
    Then the GUI displays the PEEP as 5 cmH2O in increments of 1 cmH2O

  Scenario: Display Graph of Volume Provided to Patient
    Given the volume provided to the patient is 1000 mL
    When the GUI displays the graph of volume provided
    Then the GUI displays the graph of volume provided to the patient

  Scenario: Display Flow Rate
    Given the flow rate is 10 L/min
    When the GUI displays the flow rate
    Then the GUI displays the flow rate as 10 L/min with a duration of 30 seconds updated at a rate of at least 20 Hz

  Scenario Outline: Display Patient Pressure with Various Values
    Given the controller is sending data to the GUI
    And the patient pressure is <pressure>
    When the GUI displays the patient pressure
    Then the GUI displays the patient pressure as <pressure>

    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | 10 cmH2O |
      | 20 cmH2O |
      | 30 cmH2O |
      | 40 cmH2O |
      | 50 cmH2O |

  Scenario Outline: Display Inspiratory Tidal Volume with Various Values
    Given the inspiratory tidal volume is <volume>
    When the GUI displays the inspiratory tidal volume
    Then the GUI displays the inspiratory tidal volume as <volume> with a resolution of 1 mL

    Examples:
      | volume |
      | 0 mL   |
      | 100 mL |
      | 500 mL |
      | 1000 mL|

  Scenario Outline: Display Ratio of Inspiration Time to Expiration Time with Various Values
    Given the ratio of inspiration time to expiration time is <ratio>
    When the GUI displays the ratio
    Then the GUI displays the ratio as <ratio> with a display resolution of 0.1

    Examples:
      | ratio  |
      | 10:1   |
      | 15:1   |
      | 20:1   |
      | 25:1   |
      | 1:200  |

  Scenario Outline: Display PEEP with Various Values
    Given the PEEP is <peep>
    When the GUI displays the PEEP
    Then the GUI displays the PEEP as <peep> in increments of 1 cmH2O

    Examples:
      | peep |
      | 0 cmH2O |
      | 5 cmH2O |
      | 10 cmH2O |
      | 15 cmH2O |
      | 20 cmH2O |

  Scenario Outline: Display Flow Rate with Various Values
    Given the flow rate is <flow>
    When the GUI displays the flow rate
    Then the GUI displays the flow rate as <flow> with a duration of 30 seconds updated at a rate of at least 20 Hz

    Examples:
      | flow |
      | 0 L/min |
      | 5 L/min |
      | 10 L/min |
      | 15 L/min |
      | 20 L/min |
```
